purpose: Representative carrier list for the kt carrier census (Lists phase). Reports only; decides nothing and changes no rule.
source: Cowork Limitless pull: rl/results/limitless_skill_model_2026-09-25/raw/6aa22425a4272c53be64ca36_standings.json.gz (development-split event per split.json; decklist field of the entry player=pikamon). decklist_sources.json has no Mega Lucario ex Lucario representative (it covers the six B2e archetypes only), so there is no Cowork representative to compare against.
event: The Breakfast Club Daily #5-$5 + FA (112 players)
census_cards_carried: Protective Poncho x1 (B2 147). Group 4 of the census card set: the kt draft prices Protective Poncho at 0 on both sides (cards.md, group 4), so it is not a switch-1 (groups 1 to 3) card. The list carries no Rocky Helmet and no group 1 to 3 card.
archetype_status: Sept-10 top-30 rank 1 (485 players, decks/classifier/limitless_2026-09-10.json); window rank 1 by development-half match count (2,044 decisive-or-tie records; census_summary.json). Not one of Dustin's decks: no Pokemon of the archetype name (Mega Lucario ex, Lucario) is a card in any decks/dustin or decks/brews file (census dustin_level 'none'; the recount agrees). It is, however, the panel's own lucario deck (decks/screen/opponents/t-lucario.txt has the same deck_name), so its Limitless lucario cell is a mirror and empty.
selection_rule: B2e rule: among the archetype's development-half entries that carry at least one census card (carrier_entries.csv), best placing first, larger event as the tiebreaker.
selection_note: 398 Mega Lucario ex Lucario lists in 58 development events (all 20 cards); 222 carry at least one census card (211 Protective Poncho, 18 Rocky Helmet, 7 both; census_summary.json, recount identical); 0 carry a switch-1 card. Three carrier entries placed 1st: pikamon (112 players, 2026-09-10), frozen (46, Dark League Pop Up, 2026-09-01, 8-2-1) and drakioxp (8, notChaser CUP#2 Equipe Rocket!, 2026-09-05, 6-2-0); pikamon's is the largest event, so it wins. Next by the rule: aldous 2nd of 113 (Plasma Daily #22, 2026-09-01, 8-2-1), lazimus 2nd of 57 (Dark League Pop Up, 2026-08-30, 10-1-0), thomasxavier21 2nd of 48 (2026-09-03, 9-1-0). The largest event in the window, PMPT #44 (378 players, 2026-08-29), had the archetype's best carrier at 3rd (esteban0708, 11-2-0); it would win under a largest-event-first reading, which is not the rule used. Holdout event standings were not opened (split.json lists them; only development ids were read).

printings: All 16 ids copied verbatim from the API decklist (set + zero-padded number) and resolved with python lib/card.py "<SET> <NUM>": each reports '1 printings, 1 distinct', so no printing choice was needed. The source's printings are the same ones the panel file decks/screen/opponents/t-lucario.txt uses for the 15 cards the two lists share.
energy_line: The API entry has no energy field. All five Pokémon (Riolu, Mega Lucario ex, Lucario, Bonsly, Hitmonlee) are Fighting-type per card.py, so the file's first line is 'Energy: Fighting', the same as t-lucario.txt.
diff_vs_panel_t-lucario: vs decks/screen/opponents/t-lucario.txt: -1 Copycat B1 225 (2 to 1), +1 Lucky Ice Pop B2 145; the other 19 cards and the Energy line are identical.
diff_vs_dustin: No Dustin file has a Lucario line; not applicable.

deck_check.command: python lib/deck_check.py files "rl/results/kt_carrier_census_2026-09-26/decks/c-mega_lucario_ex_lucario.txt" (from the repo root)
deck_check.output: decks clean (exit 0; no ERROR or WARN)

file_format: UTF-8 without BOM, LF line endings (checked by byte: 359 bytes, 0 CR, 17 LF, no BOM), 16 lines of '<count> <Name> <SET> <NUM>' summing to 20 cards.
holdout_discipline: Only development-half standings files were opened (the five carrier entries above, all in split.json development_event_ids, asserted before opening). matches.csv holdout rows were used only for the pooled cells in cells_c-mega_lucario_ex_lucario.py, as B2e section 3 did.
no_engine_games: No simulator game was played; goldfish ran with --games 0.
